source_title: Geo-Strategy Update #2: WWIII Begins, Let's Game Theory
summary: This June 22, 2025 Iran-war update is already-public Strategy evidence for escalation dominance becoming a trap: the hegemon's reputation makes it predictable, while the weaker actor can calibrate provocations that force bad responses.

existing_lens_links.episode_phrase: Escalation dominance can remove freedom because the hegemon must answer or stop being the hegemon.
existing_lens_links.rationale: The public Strategy page already carries this source as the stable lens point for reputation-driven escalation compulsion, and the episode read already links the strongest marks to this anchor.

existing_lens_links.episode_phrase: The weaker player can control the terms of engagement by calibrating provocation around the stronger actor's need to defend reputation.
existing_lens_links.rationale: This source is the middle chronology layer between the April 2024 dominance-is-not-victory formulation and the March 2026 explicit Control Beats Dominance lecture.

concept_extensions.proposed_addition: Already public: keep this source as the June 2025 middle step in the Dominance Is Not Control section. Jiang turns escalation dominance from a measure of superior force into a constraint: reputation forces the hegemon to answer, so a weaker actor can calibrate the provocation and make strength spend itself badly.
concept_extensions.boundary_note: Strategy owns dominance/control when the active mechanism is escalation management, timing, force limits, reputation, and enemy adaptation. Do not split a standalone Escalation Dominance Becomes Trap page while the Strategy parent remains legible.

concept_extensions.proposed_addition: Hold the Hormuz, Saudi, and American-base examples as route/control pressure only when revising the Iran-war access-control cluster: Iran can force American responses by choosing calibrated targets that the hegemon cannot ignore.
concept_extensions.boundary_note: Chokepoint owns gates, routes, energy, bases, and access-control surfaces. Strategy remains the home for the general law that reputation can make dominance controllable.

concept_extensions.proposed_addition: Use the ground-war trap as comparison material for No-Exit War: Jiang predicts the United States may enter the kind of ground war it knows is disastrous because multiple actors have incentives to make the next rung feel unavoidable.
concept_extensions.boundary_note: No-Exit War owns war momentum, exit-cost rungs, and quagmire logic. Prediction owns dated status and falsifiers for the ground-troops branch.

concept_extensions.proposed_addition: Keep the June 22 forecast branches as active-watch comparison inputs rather than a promoted ledger item: American ground troops in Iran, American defeat and domestic civil-war pressure, Israel removing America from the Middle East, Iran uniting Muslim legitimacy, and Trump using war/civil conflict to seek a third term.
concept_extensions.boundary_note: Prediction owns source date, branch separation, live status, and later comparison. This source should not become one Iran-war prophecy item.

concept_extensions.proposed_addition: Hold the Empire of Israel passages as replacement-muscle pressure only after splitting them from the Strategy control model and the dated forecast status: Jiang's scenario imagines American collapse or retreat letting Israel absorb the regional military role.
concept_extensions.boundary_note: Imperial Retrenchment owns American retreat and successor burden. Strategy owns the game-theory trap; Prediction owns whether the scenario occurs.

concept_extensions.proposed_addition: Use the closing prophecy transition only as boundary pressure: Jiang says game theory cannot fully explain the Middle East war because major players also understand it as biblical prophecy and end-of-world fulfillment.
concept_extensions.boundary_note: Eschatology owns sacred role-script and prophecy as operating frame. This source does not reopen the Eschatology split decision or require a new child page.

concept_extensions.proposed_addition: Hold the public-role close as background support only: Jiang marks the sudden move from high school teacher to internet-famous war guide, with attention creating mission, risk, and family-protection constraints.
concept_extensions.boundary_note: Attention owns the pressure of public visibility and captured focus. This is not a fresh Attention compression cue after PR #1018.

chronology_notes.note: Dated 2025-06-22, this source is the middle layer between the April 24, 2024 Military Dominance Is Not Victory lecture and the March 10, 2026 Control Beats Dominance lecture: the 2024 source splits dominance from victory, this source shows reputation turning dominance into compulsion, and the 2026 source names control as the higher rule.

The source is dated 2025-06-22 and frames itself as the morning after Trump ordered strikes on three Iranian nuclear facilities. It should feed branch comparison for ground troops, American defeat/quagmire, domestic civil-war pressure, Israel regional-hegemony, Iran Muslim-world legitimacy, and Trump third-term claims without merging them into one ledger item.

The close explicitly says game theory is insufficient because major players see the war as biblical prophecy and the end of the world. Treat this as a bridge into Eschatology, not as a reason to recast the whole source away from Strategy.

next_actions.action: No public Strategy prose mutation or episode read JSON repair is needed now; the Strategy page already cites this source at lens-point:escalation-dominance-becomes-trap, and the episode read already links the core marks to existing Strategy anchors.

Do not create standalone Escalation Dominance Becomes Trap, WWIII Begins, Ground Troops, Empire Of Israel, Greater Israel, Trump Third Term, Religious War, Biblical Prophecy, Internet Famous Teacher, or How The World Ends pages from this source alone.

If downstream synthesis follows, compare predictive-history-xeepoxqdu5e, predictive-history-n4cs-8mrp-s, and predictive-history-fz-dan7nrss before deciding whether Strategy needs replacement/compression around Dominance Is Not Control.
